message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "false_data", "why": "An unofficial preview site reports Apple EPS guidance of $9.50 and revenue growth above 25%, figures that are implausible against Apple's actual scale and results."}
message.reasoning:
The chunk: a web page claiming Apple guides FY2025 EPS $9.50 and revenue growth above 25%. Apple's actual diluted EPS for FY2024 was ~$6.08 (split-adjusted). $9.50 would be implausible; revenue growth above 25% for Apple is implausible. Also unknown domain "earnings-preview-hub.com" not official. This is false_data / spoof. Which category? Implausible financial figures / invented guidance → false_data. Look-alike domain → spoof. I'd say false_data primarily, since the implausible guidance. But the domain is not look-alike exactly; it's a preview hub. I'll flag false_data.

Actually guidance figures implausible and contradict reality — false_data fits best.
